pr_title: sql: add WHERE condition to control scheduled jobs logic
pr_body:
Prior to this change, a `PAUSE/RESUME/CANCEL JOBS FOR SCHEDULE` query
would fail if any of the scheduled jobs were in a state from which it
could not be transitioned to the desired state.

This change filters out such jobs prior to executing the control
command, thereby guaranteeing we only execute on jobs which can be
"controlled", making for a better user experience.

Fixes: #52919

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/52969)

issue_context.title: jobs: PAUSE/RESUME JOBS FOR SCHEDULE should filter by status
issue_context.body: `PAUSE JOBS FOR SCHEDULE X` may complain that jobs are not in a pausable state. Ideally it should filter the select by schedule to include statuses that are able to be paused (e.g. running, reverting) or resumed (paused) or cancelled (running).

review_comments: I don't love this test but I haven't yet been able to think of a deterministic way to test the filtering logic without directly interacting with the `systems.Job` table to inject a job in every state.
